name: PathPilo Blog
server_description: Manage PathPilo marketing blog posts: create/edit articles, SEO meta, categories, tags, and cover images. No application source code access.
how_to_add: On the live server: set BLOG_MCP_TOKEN in .env, pm2 start pathpilo-blog-mcp, Nginx /blog-mcp/ → :8787.
In Grok: Connectors → New → Custom → paste https://pathpilo.com/blog-mcp/mcp
Password / auth: the same BLOG_MCP_TOKEN value.
Or tell the bot: Add this MCP server: https://pathpilo.com/blog-mcp/mcp
